name: EtherAPI
description: Accepts Ethereum / crypto payments (via etherapi.net) for the Basket store, with a signed status callback.
project_description:
This module provides a Drupal AlternativeCommerce (Basket) payment method to embed the payment services provided by https://etherapi.net/ .

 Back to top 

 Dependencies 
 
 Drupal AlternativeCommerce (Basket) 
 
 Back to top 

 Setup 
 
 After installation, go to the payment systems settings page /admin/basket/settings-payment . 
 Create a payment point and indicate in the service "EtherAPI". 
 After you create, you will have a button to go to the settings page of the payment gateway itself. Or you can follow the link /admin/config/development/etherapi . 
 The module can also work in test mode.
